concerns.text: Task T001 is tagged `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but it creates/overwrites the project layout and dependency files (`requirements.txt`, `config.py`). These files are consumed by many subsequent tasks, so running T001 in parallel could cause race conditions. The `[P]` tag is therefore inaccurate.

Task T002 is also marked `[P]` yet it implements the core training loop (`trainer.py`, `augment.py`) which is later imported by T003, T006, and T007. Parallel execution with those consumers could lead to import errors or inconsistent code versions.

Task T003 carries the `[P]` tag but adds a CLI entry point (`train.py`) that wires together the config and trainer produced by T001 and T002. Running it concurrently with its producers would break the dependency chain.
Task T005 is marked `[P]` yet it updates `quickstart.md` to reference commands that depend on artifacts generated by T001‑T004. Parallel execution could embed stale or missing command references.
